Class ApplicationObjectSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.context.support.ApplicationObjectSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, ApplicationContextAware
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractHandlerMapping, WebApplicationObjectSupport
public abstract class ApplicationObjectSupport extends Object implements ApplicationContextAware
Convenient superclass for application objects that want to be aware of the application context, for example, for custom lookup of collaborating beans or for context-specific resource access. It saves the application context reference and provides an initialization callback method. Furthermore, it offers numerous convenience methods for message lookup.

无需继承此类：仅在需要访问上下文（例如，用于访问文件资源或消息源）时，这样做会稍微方便一些。请注意，许多应用程序对象根本不需要感知应用程序上下文，因为它们可以通过 Bean 引用接收协作 Bean。

许多框架类都派生自该类，特别是在 Web 支持中。

Author:
Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller

  • Method Details

    • setApplicationContext

      public final void setApplicationContext(@Nullable ApplicationContext context) throws BeansException
      描述从接口复制：ApplicationContextAware
      Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in. Normally this call will be used to initialize the object.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

      Specified by:
      `setApplicationContext` 接口 `ApplicationContextAware` 中
      Parameters:
      context - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象
      Throws:
      BeansException - 如果由应用程序上下文方法抛出
      See Also:
      • BeanInitializationException

    • isContextRequired

      protected boolean isContextRequired()
      Determine whether this application object needs to run in an ApplicationContext.

      默认值为"false"。可以将其覆盖以强制在上下文中运行（即，如果在上下文之外访问器则抛出 IllegalStateException）。

      See Also:
      • getApplicationContext()
      • getMessageSourceAccessor()

    • initApplicationContext

      protected void initApplicationContext(ApplicationContext context) throws BeansException
      Subclasses can override this for custom initialization behavior. Gets called by setApplicationContext after setting the context instance.

      注意：`not` 不会在上下文重新初始化时被调用，而仅在该对象的上下文引用首次初始化时调用。

      默认实现调用不带 ApplicationContext 引用的重载initApplicationContext()方法。

      Parameters:
      context - 包含的 ApplicationContext
      Throws:
      ApplicationContextException - 在初始化错误的情况下
      BeansException - 如果由 ApplicationContext 方法抛出
      See Also:
      • setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)

    • initApplicationContext

      protected void initApplicationContext() throws BeansException
